notes.title: More Beta Additions! Inference Backend Update
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey storytellers, quick dev update![/b][/h2][p]We’re still hard at work — and while the new settings menu is [b]still in beta[/b], there’s a good reason:
🔧 [b]We’ve been busy upgrading the llama-cpp backend DLL[/b] to support the [b]latest models[/b].[/p][p]Why now? Because the new settings system makes it super easy to load your own custom models and we wanted to make sure [b]the latest models work right out of the box[/b].

Maximum compatibility = maximum creative freedom. 
[/p][p]✅ This updated backend DLL is [b]now live in the Open Beta[/b] branch and ready for testing. Try it out with your favorite GGUF models and let us know how it goes!

[b]P.S.[/b] We’ve also included a new optional model file in this beta: [b]LFM2[/b], a brand-new release from Liquid.ai. It’s impressively lightweight at just [b]1.2GB[/b], making it a great option for those running on [b]6GB GPUs[/b] or even [b]8GB GPUs with other apps running in the background[/b]. It also runs surprisingly fast with CPU based inference! If you’ve struggled with getting 4GB models like Phi-3.5 to run smoothly, LFM2 should offer a [b]fast, responsive alternative[/b] that still delivers [b]fairly solid results[/b].[/p][p]That said, due to its small size and limited context window, [b]LFM2 may occasionally repeat page content or miss instruction cues[/b]. It’s only about three weeks old, so there's a good chance the creators are actively improving its instruction-following behavior. In the meantime, it’s still a fun model to experiment with while we continue to investigate these quirks and complete our rollout of full [b]cloud support[/b]. Due to it's quirks it is not enabled or used by default, you will need to add it via the settings menu's Text-Generation tab.[/p][p]Regardless of the model selected for general generation, [b]exit choice generation will continue to use the default Phi-3.5 model[/b] for now, thanks to its strong and consistent instruction-following performance.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🌩 Cloud Support News[/h3][p]We’re also making [b]great progress[/b] on a [b]modular cloud provider system[/b], which will allow us to plug in different cloud services for those of you who prefer SaaS-based (cloud service) storytelling.[/p][p]Right now, we have support for:[/p][list][*][p]🦙 [b]Ollama[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🧠 [b]Gemini[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]More are coming [b]over the next two weeks[/b], and we’re planning another [b]Open Beta update[/b] soon that adds this cloud support for everyone to try. This modular approach means easier maintenance, better performance, and more choices for you.

Here's a sample video showing the speed you can expect when using Gemini to generate the story page, exits, and image: [url="https://imgur.com/a/9QMEiZD"]https://imgur.com/a/9QMEiZD[/url] Since all the 'heavy lifting' is done by a cloud provider, it should run this fast on almost any hardware setup.
[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thanks again for being part of this journey! Your feedback and support make it all possible. If you haven’t tried the beta branch yet, now’s a great time to jump in and help us shape the next evolution of local (and soon cloud-powered) storytelling.[/p][p]As always, happy adventuring
Chris[/p]

notes.title: 🎮 A Letter to Our Community - Enhanced Settings System Now in Open Beta
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Constant Readers,[/h2][p] I’ve got a lot to share - but if you're the tl;dr type, scroll to the bottom for the short version.

When I started building this game, I had a vision: true local AI storytelling where your stories, your choices, and your data stay completely yours. No servers, no subscriptions, no compromises. Just you and the infinite possibilities of AI-powered storytelling - without getting cut off right when things are getting good because you hit a token limit. I've been there and it sucks. [/p][p]But this journey started even simpler than that. I wrote the first prototype version of this for my 3-year-old daughter Molly - to make our storytelling nights more magical. Then I started having so much fun with it that I thought other folks might enjoy it too.[/p][p]That's why we're here today.
[/p][h2]You Made This Possible:[/h2][p]I launched this on my late Grandfather's birthday toward the end of March, not knowing if anyone would care about local AI gaming. Some Steam games sell 20 copies and disappear. But y'all? Hundreds upon hundreds of you believed in this vision. You bought it, you played it, you gave feedback, you stuck with me through rough patches.[/p][p][b]Thank you, truly[/b] 🥹.[/p][p]Without you, this would just be a bedtime story app for Molly and I. Instead, it's become something real, something meaningful, something that's growing every week because you made it matter. Thank y'all for helping to make this better for everyone else.[/p][p]Every sale, every review, every bug report - you turned a dad's coding project into an actual game that people love. That's humbling beyond words. I owe you and will continue to support this for as long as you guys keep showing up to play and purchase it. That's the least I can do in return for the trust you've given me. You trusted me with your money and your time. That trust means everything to me.
[/p][h2]What's in Open Beta Right Now:[/h2][p]I spent the whole weekend [b]rebuilding our settings system from the ground up[/b]. No more guessing what text models you have configured or image models you've copied over the standard files.[/p][p]The new system gives you complete transparency and control over what is running:[/p][list][*][p] 🎚 [b]Quality Sliders[/b] – Simple Low/Medium/High presets for both text and image models[/p][/*][*][p]🔍 [b]Visual Model Paths[/b] – See exactly which model file each quality level uses[/p][/*][*][p]📁 [b]Easy Browse Buttons[/b] – Click to browse and set custom models for each quality level[/p][/*][*][p]📦 [b]File Size Display[/b] – Know exactly how big each model is before you use it[/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Active Indicators[/b] – Clear checkmarks show which quality setting you're currently using[/p][/*][*][p]🧠 [b]Smart Fallback[/b] – If a custom model goes missing, the system automatically reverts to using the included SD1.5 or Phi 3.5 model - no crashes, no broken text or image generation, no excuses[/p][/*][*][p]📂 [b]Smart Organization[/b] – Everything grouped logically so you can find what you need[/p][/*][/list][p]This isn't magic that reads your mind - it's transparency that respects your intelligence. You can see what's configured, easily change it, and understand exactly what the system is using at a glance.

We've also added some much-needed [b]enhancements to image generation[/b]. There's now a stop button that cuts things short when you've picked a model that's running too slow. And when generation finishes, a new regenerate button gives you another shot if the image doesn't match your vision. Keep going until the AI delivers exactly what you're picturing.

[b]The new settings system and image regeneration feature is live on the Open Beta branch on Steam right now[/b]. Please help me test it, break it - tell me what you like and what you don't. Together we'll polish it until it's perfect.[/p][h2]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526956/a7977ce369e59f7ed4f702d51339cf8c0275adc2.png"][/img]What's Coming Down The Pipeline Next:[/h2][p]Many of you want storytelling magic but don't have the hardware for local AI. I hear you loud and clear. SaaS support is already in development - ChatGPT, Claude, and other cloud services integration is actively being worked on. Yes, you'll still hit their token limits and subscription walls, but at least you'll get to experience the storytelling magic while you save up for proper hardware.[/p][p]Your vision matters as much as mine. I believe in local AI freedom, but I believe in your happiness even more.[/p][p]Not only that, but we've also got a savegame manager in the pipeline right now too that will let you manage multiple saves and easily tell between them at a glance. This will allow you to have different stories, going at different times, to suit whatever mood you're feeling at the moment.[/p][p]This is our journey, [b]together[/b]. I've been trying to maintain weekly updates, but it's been two weeks since the last one because I've honestly been running low on steam (no pun intended!). Building this while juggling a day job and family life - coding this at 4:30 AM before my darling Molly wakes up - is taking its toll. But I keep pushing forward because you've shown me this matters to more than just me. Thank you all for giving me my 2nd wind.[/p][h2]
One More Way to Help:[/h2][p]There's one more way you can help shape this journey: [b]reviews[/b]. Whether positive or negative, every piece of feedback helps me understand what's working and what needs improvement. Plus, it helps other storytellers discover what we're building together. I know leaving reviews isn't usually top of mind (it isn't for me either!), but it would mean a lot.[/p][p]
With my deepest respect and neverending gratitude,
Chris

[i]P.S. - Molly, if you're reading this in 20 years: Daddy built this because he loved our story time so much he wanted to share that magic with everyone. Every line of code was written with you in mind, every feature designed to make storytelling as wonderful as our nights together. You were my inspiration then, and you always will be.


[/i]tl;dr:🔧 NOW IN OPEN BETA: Complete settings overhaul with quality presets, easy browsing, and the control this technology deserves. COMING SOON: SaaS integration and a Save Manager for managing multiple savegames.[/p]

notes.title: 🛠️ Weekend Update: Save System, Progress Viewer, Smarter Hardware Detection
notes.content:
[p]Hey Constant Readers,[/p][p]We've just rolled out another huge update, focused on giving players more control, wider hardware support, and a better story-tracking experience.[/p][p]Whether you're deep in Story Mode or just starting out, this update brings long-awaited features and key fixes -- and sets the stage for what's next.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]📖 [b]New: Story Objective Viewer[/b][/h3][p]We’ve added a new in-game tool to help you stay oriented during structured story mode:[/p][list][*][p]✅ [b]Chapter Tracking:[/b] You’ll now see how many objectives you've completed (e.g. "3/5 complete") at the bottom of the screen.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Hover for Details:[/b] Hover over the chapter name to see a full breakdown of what's been completed and what's still in progress. These are hidden and only available on hover so that we don't spoil the story for you. If you've ever wondered why the AI keeps trying to send you back to the same place -- this will make that logic crystal clear.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Flexible Progression:[/b] You don’t have to check off [i]every[/i] objective to move forward -- completing at least [b]70%[/b] of them is enough to unlock the next chapter. You can follow your story, bend it, or complete it however you'd like.[/p][/*][/list][p]Once you finish the final chapter, you’ll automatically transition into [b]Free Exploration Mode[/b], where you're free to explore, create, and continue the story indefinitely (or as far as your hardware will allow).

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526956/556eb7112b279b35e7b1073b78b7add3577af755.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]💾 [b]Save System (Finally!)[/b][/h3][p]You can now save your progress and pick up where you left off -- even including your [b]last generated image[/b]![/p][p]The current system supports one story at a time and includes your full story state — including character, item, story, and location memories -- chapter & beat progress, as well as your last generated image.[/p][p]A full save manager (with multiple slots) is already in development and will be rolled out in a future update![/p][hr][/hr][h3]⚙️ [b]New Hardware Support: CPU Inference Mode & GPU Tuning[/b][/h3][p]We've made big changes under the hood to help more players run the game -- even on lower-end hardware that is below our recommended requirements:[/p][p]🧠 [b]CPU Inference Mode[/b][/p][p]We’ve added options in [b]Settings[/b] to switch both image and text generation to CPU-based inference by setting the model to use [b]0 GPU layers[/b].[/p][p]While CPU mode is significantly slower, it allowed us to successfully play the game on [b]Intel integrated graphics (13900K)[/b] at a reasonable speed -- and we’re thrilled that this gives more players a shot at enjoying the game.[/p][quote][p]⚠️ Note: System monitors may still show GPU activity in CPU inference mode. This is normal - the underlying llama.cpp engine initializes GPU contexts and keeps memory 'warm' for offloading, but all actual text generation happens on your CPU.[/p][/quote][p]📊 [b]Smart GPU Detection + Manual Override[/b][/p][p]We detect your GPU by name and now match it to a built-in VRAM database to automatically decide how many LLM layers to offload.[/p][p]And for tinkerers:[/p][list][*][p]✅ [b]New Override Field in Settings[/b]: You can now manually enter the number of layers to offload if you want finer control.[/p][/*][*][p]📉 If your system is tight on VRAM (especially if it’s shared with background apps), lowering the offload count can greatly reduce instability.[/p][/*][/list][p]These tweaks mainly affect a [i]very small[/i] number of systems — but if you're playing on tight VRAM, low-end hardware, or complex Windows environments, you may see better stability here.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🖥️ [b]Better Stability on Edge Cases[/b][/h3][p]We’ve also improved compatibility with systems that were just at or barely under our recommended spec or have uncommon configurations -- especially systems affected by aggressive VRAM limits and with different protections or antivirus software that may prevent writing to folders where we save the game and settings data.[/p][p]Fixes include:[/p][list][*][p]Display mode fallback logic (if your driver doesn’t support switching resolutions)[/p][/*][*][p]Safer file system handling (for environments with locked folders or aggressive antivirus)[/p][/*][*][p]More graceful failures in weird setups (instead of crashing or hanging)[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]⚠️ Removed: Flux Model Support[/h3][p]We've removed support for [b]Flux[/b] image generation models and are no longer bundling them with the game. If you were using Flux previously, the game will now automatically fall back to the standard Stable Diffusion model -- no action needed on your part.

We will be adding them as a DLC package (free, of course) later this week, that way customers that don't intend on using them don't have to waste disk space on them anymore as they more than doubled the size of the game! 

We are still huge believers in flux as the quality of generation really is fantastic, we just want to ensure we deliver it in the best possible way for our customers that aren't running high powered battle-stations.

More to come on this in a midweek update![/p][hr][/hr][h3]🧪 Sneak Peek: New Settings Menu In Development[/h3][p]We’re currently testing a redesigned settings UI that’s a massive step up in usability and clarity. 

📸 Here’s a preview of what’s coming:[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526956/f3f6e84af421000a264e57935940708e4d68b547.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ll share more about this in the next update -- but we wanted to keep you in the loop on what's coming next!

With all our love and neverending imagination,[/p][p]🪄 [b]The Neverending AI Storybook Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Major Update!
notes.content:
[h2]🧭 Storymode vs Freedom Mode[/h2]

You now have two ways to play:

[b]Storymode[/b] (guided)
  [*] A guided experience powered by the new Story Director, Beat System, and Knowledge Graph. This mode helps shape your journey with structure and memory, giving your adventure a sense of pacing and continuity.
  [*] Builds structure, memory, and momentum.
  [*] Gentle nudges to keep you on track when you deviate too far from the main story path.

[b]Freedom Mode[/b] (unguided)
  [*] For those who prefer a blank slate, Freedom Mode offers completely open-ended storytelling with no narrative guidance. No beats. No outlines. No interference. Just you and your imagination.

Choose your mode from the [b]Overview[/b] panel before you begin.


[h2]🎬 Story Director, Beats & Knowledge Graph[/h2]

In Storymode, three systems work together to elevate your narrative:

[b]Knowledge Graph[/b]  
  [*] Tracks characters, places, objects, and relationships as you play.  
  [*] Helps stories remember what matters and bring it back naturally.

[b]Beat System[/b]  
  [*] Divides stories into emotional milestones like setup, conflict, climax, and resolution.  
  [*] Keeps stories moving and gives them rhythm — without locking you in.

[b]Story Director[/b]  
  [*] Reads your story in real time.  
  [*] Helps guide pacing, callbacks, and meaningful developments.  
  [*] Responds to [i]your[/i] choices rather than forcing its own.


[h2]🖼️ Image Model Choice: Flux Support[/h2]

Choose the image model that best fits your hardware and storytelling needs:

[*][b]SD 1.5[/b] – Optimized for older systems and lower-end GPUs. Faster render times with a smaller memory footprint, so everyone can get images—even on limited hardware.  
[*][b]Flux[/b] – Uses larger models for richer, more cohesive art. While generation takes a bit longer, Flux delivers superior instruction following, reliably capturing most details from your page in a single, dramatic scene.

[quote]Note: The style dropdown is temporarily removed while we work on supporting [b]LoRA models compatible with both SD 1.5 and Flux[/b].[/quote]


[h2]⚙️ UI & Polish[/h2]

[*] Outline is hidden by default (to avoid spoilers) — toggle visibility if you'd like via the checkbox.
[*] Fixed a bug where the recap or story overview background would remain onscreen in certain cases.  
[*] Font fix for better compatibility of the text based progress bars.
[*] Revamped the spinner system we previously had and relocated it to the status panel.
[*] Smarter layout updates based on mode.


[h2]🔔 Toast Notifications[/h2]

We’ve added a lightweight system for [b]toast-style messages[/b] to confirm actions and display messages. It’s minimal now, but sets the stage for future feedback inside the interface that we plan on building upon.


[h2]🛠️ Other Fixes[/h2]

[*] CUDA support re-enabled.  
[*] Smoother image re-generation logic and spinner cleanup.
[*] Updated prompt logic so that any consequences of your input in the text field usually appear immediately in the very first paragraph of the next page. Previously, your actions might get pushed into the 2nd or 3rd paragraph, which could make input feel delayed or not properly acted upon.


[h2]❤️ A Heartfelt Thank You[/h2]

[b]You’re the reason we burn the midnight oil,
the reason we’ve stolen weekends and late nights away from our day jobs and families.[/b]  

Every moment you spend in Neverending AI Storybook makes those sacrifices worth it. Your imagination fuels ours, and [b]we couldn’t do this without you[/b]. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for your continued support and taking this wild journey with us!

[i]— With all our gratitude (and a strong cup of coffee),
The Neverending AI Storybook Team[/i]

notes.title: Exciting Update: GraphRAG and Beat System Coming Soon!
notes.content:
We're making excellent progress on two major enhancements for our AI storybook game! Here's a peek behind the scenes at what we're working on.

[h2]New Graph-Based Knowledge System[/h2]

We're completely transforming how our stories remember details with a new Graph-based Retrieval Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) system. This creates a dynamic knowledge graph that tracks:
[list]  [*]Characters and their evolving states[/*]  [*]Locations and their properties[/*]  [*]Items discovered throughout the adventure[/*]  [*]Key events that have occurred[/*][/list]
Instead of each page being generated with only the last few pages in mind, the system builds interconnected nodes and relationships, allowing stories to maintain remarkable consistency. Characters will remember past interactions, locations will persist with their unique attributes, and past events will influence future developments.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/yz0lLlL.png[/img]

[h2]Enhanced Beat System[/h2]
Alongside this, we're implementing a structured three-act narrative framework with distinct story beats. Each beat includes:
[list]  [*]Key characters involved in the scene[/*]  [*]Specific locations[/*]  [*]Suggested events that can unfold[/*][/list]
This means stories will have better pacing, more compelling arcs, and increased narrative coherence as you play through them.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3AESU3G.png[/img]
[h2]Technical Challenges We've Conquered[/h2]
Building these systems hasn't been easy! We've tackled:
[list]  [*][b]Knowledge graph construction[/b]: Creating a dynamic graph that evolves as the story progresses[/*]  [*][b]Text embeddings[/b]: Using semantic embedding vectors to find related story elements[/*]  [*][b]Robust JSON parsing[/b]: Building a resilient parser that can extract meaningful story elements from imperfect LLM outputs[/*]  [*][b]Beat completion detection[/b]: Cleverly detecting when you've satisfied the requirements of a story beat[/*][/list][h2]What This Means For Players[/h2]
As these updates launch, you'll experience:
[list]  [*]Stories that truly remember details from earlier pages[/*]  [*]More coherent narratives with classic story structure[/*]  [*]Characters who maintain consistent personalities and motivations[/*]  [*]Locations that feel more like real, persistent places[/*]  [*]Items that remain in your inventory and have ongoing significance[/*]  [*]Plots that build toward meaningful climaxes[/*][/list]

We're particularly excited about how these systems work together - when you make unexpected choices, the story will dynamically replan its future while maintaining all the relationships and knowledge it's built up.

Stay tuned for more updates as we put the finishing touches on these exciting new systems!

notes.title: Update Notes for April 26th 2025
notes.content:
[h1]New Update Highlights:[/h1]

[list]
[*] 🧠 New Local Model Available:
We've included a new local model -- Psyfighter 2 (8.7GB) -- focused on delivering higher-quality text generation. It's not enabled by default, but it's available for users who want to experiment with even richer storytelling.

(Fun fact: Psyfighter 2 was the model we used during most of development! It writes rich, natural stories -- and it’s completely Fiche'-free.)
 
[*] 🔧 Improved User-Supplied Model Handling:
You’ve always been able to load your own model for storytelling -- but now, even if your model doesn't strictly follow instructions, the system will still use the included Phi-3.5 model for exit generation.
This ensures you have complete freedom for creative storytelling while maintaining the structured precision needed for certain gameplay functions.

[*] 🐞 Race Condition Fix:
Fixed a rare issue where users could start a new generation session while the system was already mid-generation by quickly using the Action Input Bar. Thanks to Daniel for reporting this!

[*] ⚡GPU Hardware Check:
We've added a hardware check on the title screen that will alert users if their GPU doesn't meet the minimum requirements for a smooth experience.

[*] 🖥️ Cuda Support Rolled Back:
We introduced CUDA support in the last update, but after receiving reports of issues from some users, we've decided to roll it back for now while we investigate further. Thanks for your patience and understanding!

[*] 🖼️ Stable Diffusion Backend Update
We’ve updated our Stable Diffusion backend to the latest version, bringing enhanced performance and improved image generation capabilities.

[*] 🕹️ Basic Gamepad Support:
We've introduced initial gamepad support, complete with an on-screen keyboard for text input. Most of the game is now accessible by gamepad (except the settings menu, which is currently being reworked).
This feature was added to bring a little more comfort and accessibility to friends in our community who benefit from alternative input options.
[/list]

[h1]🔮A Glimpse at the Future:
Story Continuity Overhaul[/h1]
In this update, we've disabled the old story_director function, as it wasn't doing a strong enough job keeping stories "on the rails."

In its place -- starting in beta now -- we've implemented a KnowledgeGraph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system.

This new system tracks items, locations, characters, and even their current states inside a flexible knowledge graph, and uses that information to maintain continuity and context as your story evolves.

It’s already a massive improvement for story flow, and we're really excited to hear your feedback on it once we push it live. Stay tuned -- more refinements are on the way!

Thank you all for your continued support — we're just getting started! 🚀

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2tCmV49.png[/img]

notes.title: Update Notes for April 10th 2025
notes.content:
🚀 New & Improved
Lazy Loading for Model File Loaders
We've implemented lazy loading for model files to prevent UI freezing or lag during startup and generation. This significantly improves responsiveness, especially on machines with slower disk speeds or limited I/O performance.

Support for Flux Image Model DLC (Coming Soon!)
Added backend support for our upcoming Flux Image Model DLC — a brand-new, free image generation model that brings exciting new capabilities to our app.

🔍 About Flux (vs. Stable Diffusion 1.5)
The Flux image model is a next-gen model we've optimized for creative generation. Compared to Stable Diffusion 1.5, Flux offers:

[list]
[*] Sharper detail resolution, particularly in textures and background objects.
[*] Better understanding of abstract prompts, making it more expressive for surreal or conceptual artwork.
[*] Improved composition balance, reducing artifacts and strange object placement.
[*] Faster generation on mid-range GPUs thanks to internal optimizations.
[*] More inclusive and varied dataset for broader subject diversity and visual accuracy.
[/list]

Stay tuned — Flux will be available soon as a free DLC that we expect to be in the range of 12-15GB
